Nothing in the tree was executed.

claims: lean/Sqpack/Rect.lean defines RectPacks n w h, n closed unit squares (any angles) in [0,w] x [0,h] with pairwise disjoint interiors, from Basic.lean's sq and sqInt, and states theorem SquarePacking.rect2_iff {w h : ℝ} : RectPacks 2 w h ↔ 1 ≤ w ∧ 1 ≤ h ∧ (2 ≤ w ∨ 2 ≤ h) (74937b01, 2026-10-21T04:34:52Z).

Rect3.lean states rect3_iff {w h : ℝ} : RectPacks 3 w h ↔ 1 ≤ w ∧ 1 ≤ h ∧ ((2 ≤ w ∧ 2 ≤ h) ∨ 3 ≤ w ∨ 3 ≤ h ∨ (h < 2 ∧ 4 + 2√2 ≤ w + 2h) ∨ (w < 2 ∧ 4 + 2√2 ≤ h + 2w)) (b7d9b1bf, 2026-10-21T14:23:57Z), and Rect4.lean rect4_iff {w h : ℝ} : RectPacks 4 w h ↔ 1 ≤ w ∧ 1 ≤ h ∧ ((2 ≤ w ∧ 2 ≤ h) ∨ 4 ≤ w ∨ 4 ≤ h ∨ (h < 2 ∧ Fried4 w h) ∨ (w < 2 ∧ Fried4 h w)) (ee4d2cce, 2026-10-21T16:05:00Z), Friedman's piece of S_3; at w = h they give s(2) = s(3) = s(4) = 2.

Rect5Pts.lean states rect5_pts_lower {a b : ℝ} (ha : 2 ≤ a) (hb : 2 ≤ b) (ha' : a < 2√2) (hb' : b < 2√2) (hab : a + b < 4 + √2) : ¬ RectPacks 5 a b, by four unavoidable points, and Rect5Pack.lean rect5_upper, whose case 2 ≤ w ∧ 2 ≤ h ∧ 4 + √2 ≤ w + h packs five squares at w = h = 2 + 1/√2 (e96ab691, 2026-10-21T20:10:45Z). At a = b they give s(5) = 2 + 1/√2 for sides at least 2; no theorem states minSide or s(5) itself.

lean/Axioms.lean is the source's probe that prints each headline theorem's axioms, rect2_iff, rect3_iff, rect4_iff, rect5_upper and rect5_pts_lower among them; the commit messages of b7d9b1bf and ee4d2cce say standard axioms. No axiom output or build log is published.
